html:
SMTO-KV-0007 — A scratch note was too large to save

GUID: 3b3da87c-d194-4d2c-9d4f-dfb3862b931e
Slug: kv-value-too-large
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The Agent tried to save one scratch note larger than 16 KB for this Task. That note wasn't saved, and the other notes are unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait to see whether the Run continues. The Agent sees this error and can split the note into smaller parts or save a shorter summary. Each scratch note can hold at most 16 KB of text, so smaller pieces fit.
  2. If the Run stopped, send a follow-up asking the Agent to split the information into several smaller notes or keep only a short summary. Splitting keeps all the information without anything being cut off without your knowledge.
  3. If the Agent keeps hitting this limit, ask it to report the large result to you in its reply instead of saving it as a note. Scratch notes are meant for small working details, not large results.

What success looks like

  • The Run's activity shows Saved task scratch data for the smaller notes.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask the Agent to quietly cut the text short; part of the information would be lost.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV rejected kv.put because the value's UTF-8 encoding is larger than MAX_VALUE_BYTES (16 KiB) for a single entry.

What this means

  • UTF-8 encoding succeeds but the resulting value size exceeds MAX_VALUE_BYTES. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • UTF-8 encoding succeeds but the resulting value size exceeds MAX_VALUE_BYTES.

How to diagnose it

  • Measure encoded bytes rather than character count and retain the full value when splitting it.

How to fix it

  • The limit is MAX_VALUE_BYTES = 16 * 1024, checked by validate_value in src/agent_runtime/kv/models.py. Split the value across several keys or store a reduced summary, and never truncate silently; the conversation total is still capped at 256 entries and 512 KiB.
  • Reduce or split the value to fit the operation’s advertised byte limit; do not silently truncate.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Each deliberately split value fits the supported byte bound without silent loss.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
